method.waveform: Normalized valid-lag PCM correlation with local mean/variance; additional300-3500Hz search avoids accepting a shared low-frequency beat as identity
method.spectral: 40log-frequency band energies plus temporal differences; per-band local mean removal and reference-derived whitening;25fps; searches candidate timeline playback rate0.90-1.10
method.identityCriterion: At least3 nonoverlapping windows with midband PCM>=.55 and coherent offsets<=50ms, OR spectralpattern>=.80 with coherent offsets<=100ms and rates<=.005 apart. Spectral similarity alone below this cannot establish an exact track
